title: One Voice Governance
goal: Author, generate, verify, and review One Voice action contracts and Kai compatibility runtime contracts so voice, typed search, UI actionables, persona gating, and durable memory boundaries stay aligned under one shared gateway.
required_commands: cd consent-protocol && python3 -m pytest tests/test_one_adk_live_protocol.py tests/services/test_agent_chat_service.py -q

commands: cd consent-protocol && python3 -m pytest tests/test_one_adk_live_protocol.py tests/services/test_agent_chat_service.py -q
tests: cd consent-protocol && python3 -m pytest tests/test_one_adk_live_protocol.py tests/services/test_agent_chat_service.py -q

deliverables: generated shared gateway and route orchestration index
updated One Voice runtime and contributor docs
common_failures: adding voice-discoverable behavior without a local action contract
treating runtime surface metadata as the source of capability existence
allowing voice and search to mint different action ids for the same capability
authoring persona-sensitive actions without central guard coverage
guessing multi-step flows instead of explicitly authoring workflows
letting durable voice memory fall back to plaintext browser storage
changing the gateway without rebuilding generated artifacts or updating targeted tests
